title: Timed delivery
goal: Reach the drop point, stay there for 20 s, then come back and land, all in under 4 minutes.

steps.text: Take off, then use Go to on the drop point and keep it there for 20 seconds.
steps.hint: Arm and Take off in the Control tab, then press Go to and click the drop point. It holds there by itself.

steps.text: Bring it back and land at home.
steps.hint: Return to launch flies it home and lands it by itself.

passed: Passed. There and back in {elapsed} s.
